name: Single jersey
plainEnglish: The standard t-shirt knit. Flat face, looped back, light and breathable.
takesPrint: Very well — the smooth face suits screen, DTF and DTG.

name: Pique
plainEnglish: The textured waffle knit used for polos. Structured, holds its shape, breathes well.
takesPrint: Embroidery suits it best; the texture works against fine print detail.

name: Interlock
plainEnglish: Double-knit construction. Smooth on both sides, heavier and more stable than single jersey.
usedFor: Garments needing a clean print surface
takesPrint: Excellent — the dense, smooth face is the best cotton base for detailed print.

name: Rib
plainEnglish: Stretchy vertical-ribbed knit that recovers its shape. Used as trim rather than body fabric.
takesPrint: Not used as a print surface.

name: Fleece
plainEnglish: Brushed on the inside for warmth. The standard hoodie and sweatshirt fabric.
takesPrint: Good for bold artwork; brushing softens very fine detail.

name: Loop knit
plainEnglish: Unbrushed looped back. Lighter than fleece, cleaner surface, better for warmer climates.
takesPrint: Better than fleece for detailed print.

name: Performance poly knit
plainEnglish: Polyester knit that moves moisture away from the skin. The base for sublimation.
takesPrint: The only construction that accepts true sublimation — dye bonds into the fibre.
